title: Mail: an edited compose window autosaves to Drafts and closing without sending keeps it
pending: Pending: needs a FACTS entry that can see the local Drafts mailbox/row count from the behaviour harness (none exists yet; `rmac-mail-storage`'s `allocate_local_uid`/`put_message`/`clear_attachments` are covered by its own unit tests in the meantime), the fixture app wired to read real storage snapshots instead of the static fixture (MAIL-4/MAIL-9), and a Mac recording of the Mac's own autosave timing against a local 'On My Mac' mailbox only. Never send mail and never confirm a deletion on the Mac.
